title: Voltgear EV Tracking Mobile App
summary: An EV tracking experience that helps riders monitor battery, routes, and vehicle health in real time.
description:
Voltgear needed a mobile product that felt as sharp as their hardware. I led product design from research to high-fidelity UI, focusing on glanceable battery data, trip history, and a calm dark interface built for night rides.

The result is a tracking app with clear hierarchy, fast status checks, and a case-study ready visual system that scales across iOS and Android.

title: Finora Analytics
summary: A SaaS analytics dashboard that turns dense financial data into decisions founders can act on.
description:
Finora's previous dashboard was packed but hard to scan. I redesigned information architecture, charts, and filters so revenue, churn, and cohort insights feel immediate.

The interface uses a quiet layout with strong typography and progressive disclosure — power users get depth without overwhelming first-time visitors.

title: Nord Commerce
summary: Brand and storefront design for a modern commerce brand with a clean northern aesthetic.
description:
Nord wanted an e-commerce presence that felt premium without becoming cold. I shaped the visual identity, product pages, and shopping flow around spacious layouts, soft contrast, and confident product photography.

Conversion-focused details — sticky buy actions, clearer variants, and trust blocks — shipped alongside the brand system.
